morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词借词，保留词首 /sl/ 辅音连缀，读一个音节；下列为复合表达，不是加缀派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 小而狭长的纸片或纸条，常用于记录资料、出具凭证；在 slip gaji 中指列明工资、津贴和扣款等项目的工资单。
senses.en_definition: A small, narrow piece of paper, especially one bearing information or serving as a record or voucher.
senses.nuances: 核心释义据《Kamus Dewan》第四版，展开了原文缩写。slip gaji 的重点是工资明细，不能一律译为“收据”。电子工资单也常称 slip gaji。此处不引入英语 slip 的“滑倒”等其他义项。frequency_rank 沿用输入数据。[DBP PRPM：slip](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=slip)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 人事行政通知
dual_scenarios.ms: Pemohon diminta mengemukakan salinan slip gaji bagi tiga bulan terkini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 申请人须提交最近三个月的工资单副本。
dual_scenarios.en: Applicants are requested to submit copies of their payslips for the latest three months.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Slip gaji bulan ni dah ada kat portal, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Slip gaji bulan ini sudah tersedia di portal, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个月的工资单已经放在系统里了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: This month's payslip is on the portal already, right?
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语缩略形式
kat 对应表示地点的 di
kan 用于确认共同信息

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah muat turun slip gaji bulan ni?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah memuat turun slip gaji bulan ini?
messages.zh: 你下载这个月的工资单了吗？
messages.en: Have you downloaded this month's payslip yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Nak tengok, buka je portal staf.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Jika awak hendak melihatnya, buka sahaja portal kakitangan.
messages.zh: 下了。你想看的话，打开员工系统就行。
messages.en: Yes. Just open the staff portal if you want to check yours.

etymology.historical_story: Malay slip corresponds to the English noun for a narrow piece of paper. That English sense developed from an older meaning referring to a narrow strip or piece. In Malaysian administrative vocabulary, compounds such as slip gaji connect the word with documentary records. The paper sense has its own history, distinct from simply slipping or falling. [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/slip), [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=slip)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 slip 和一张细长凭条绑定：加 gaji（工资）就是 slip gaji（工资单）。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: slip 是中性行政用词。向对方索取文件时可说 Sila kemukakan salinan slip gaji，语气比直接命令交出原件更合适。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 工资单涉及个人薪资资料，适合在人事、财务或相关申请程序中讨论；在群聊中应避免随意公开他人的工资单。
